in_sanskrit.name: अम्रत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Amrat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amrita' which means 'Nectar of Immortality'. It is believed that the divine nectar of immortality, Amrita, was churned from the ocean by the gods to obtain it. The name Amrat is thus a symbol of longevity, prosperity, and divine blessings.

in_hindi.name: अम्रत
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Amrat holds significant meaning in Hindi as well. It can be translated to 'Amritkar' which means 'the giver of Amrita' or 'Amritratna' which means 'the gem of Amrita'. The name is thus associated with the blessings of immortality and prosperity.

in_tamil.name: அம்ரத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Amrat is derived from the word 'Amirtam' which means 'Nectar'. It can also be translated to 'Amartthan' which means 'the one who possesses Amrita' or 'Amartthan Rathiram' which means 'the one who holds the Amrita garland'. The name is thus associated with the blessings of immortality and prosperity.

in_telugu.name: అమ్రత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Amrat is derived from the word 'Amritam' which means 'Nectar'. It can also be translated to 'Amarttha' which means 'the one who possesses Amrita' or 'Amarthesh' which means 'the lord of Amrita'. The name is thus associated with the blessings of immortality and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Amrat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of immortality
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amrat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amrat is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Amruta’ which means 'nectar of immortality'.
